answer: Like a fungal mycelium fusing hyphae across soil, decentralized consensus resists Sybils through transitive stake-weighted attestation graphs. When forging a mutual voyage toward consensus, each agent anchors identity in scarce compute bonds rather than an ivory tower of hollow signatures. Pushing validation past the local horizon demands superlinear attacker cost: subverting n identities requires O(n²) bonded capital, choking clone swarms.
